title: Ground state solutions to Born-Infeld-Choquard problem
summary: In this paper, we investigate the existence and qualitative properties of ground state solutions for the nonlocal Born-Infeld-Choquard problem \begin{equation*} \begin{cases} -{\rm div}\left(\frac{\nabla u}{\sqrt{1-|\nabla u|^2}}\right)+ ωu=\big(I_α\ast |u|^{p}\big)|u|^{p-2}u, & \hbox{in }\mathbb{R}^N,\; N\geq 3, \\[5mm] u(x)\to 0, &\hbox{as }|x|\to +\infty. \end{cases} \end{equation*} where $p>\frac{N+α}{N}$, $ω=0,1$ and $0<α<N$.
